chains.question_answered: Is AI capex a real demand pool and what can it prove?
chains.business_mechanism: Hyperscaler capex funds compute capacity, data centers, networking and accelerators, but does not allocate dollars to suppliers without deployment/order evidence.
chains.minimum_quality_bar: Capex must be treated as demand-pool evidence, not as supplier allocation.
failure_conditions: capex is written as DELL/NVDA/ASML order proof
chains.writer_must_say: AI capex supports the existence of demand, but supplier capture needs product/deployment/supply-chain/financial bridge evidence.

chains.question_answered: How do NVIDIA, AMD and Google TPU differ in product capability and substitution risk?
chains.business_mechanism: Architecture, memory, interconnect, software ecosystem and benchmark/deployment evidence shape bargaining power, supply bottlenecks and substitution boundaries.
chains.minimum_quality_bar: Product layer can be judged without SKU revenue, but cannot infer revenue, ASP, shipment or share.
failure_conditions: missing SKU revenue is treated as product-analysis failure
desktop/client product spec is substituted for AI accelerator spec
chains.writer_must_say: Use product/spec/deployment evidence to judge product capability and substitution, while keeping revenue/share inference out of scope.

chains.question_answered: Who is deploying, configuring or adopting AI infrastructure products?
chains.business_mechanism: Official cloud/OEM/customer deployment converts product capability and demand pool into adoption evidence, but still does not prove total order size or margin.
chains.minimum_quality_bar: Distinguish official deployment/configuration from demand proxy and relationship graph scope.
failure_conditions: relationship graph is used as deployment fact
generic partner page is used as customer order proof
chains.writer_must_say: Deployment and OEM configuration support adoption direction, not total sales or margin unless order/backlog/financial rows exist.

chains.question_answered: Is Dell AI server growth high-quality profit or low-margin revenue pass-through?
chains.business_mechanism: AI server orders/backlog must flow through shipments, ISG revenue, gross/operating margin, GPU pass-through cost, attach rate, working capital and cash conversion.
chains.minimum_quality_bar: Revenue visibility and margin quality must be separated.
failure_conditions: orders/backlog are written as proof of margin improvement
consolidated revenue/gross profit is used as AI server margin
chains.writer_must_say: Dell has supported AI server revenue visibility if order/backlog rows exist, but margin-quality proof requires ISG margin and AI server mix/pass-through bridge.

chains.question_answered: How does AI demand read through to foundry, packaging, HBM and semicap equipment?
chains.business_mechanism: AI accelerator demand drives leading-edge foundry, packaging, memory/HBM and equipment process intensity, but each equipment vendor has different mechanisms.
chains.minimum_quality_bar: Separate TSMC, ASML, AMAT, LRCX and KLAC mechanisms; peer group scope is not evidence.
failure_conditions: semicap peers are treated as identical
generic revenue is used as AI-specific backlog/order evidence
chains.writer_must_say: AI supports semicap read-through only through vendor-specific WFE, EUV/DUV, deposition/etch, process-control, advanced packaging or services evidence.

chains.question_answered: Is the AI infrastructure thesis already priced in?
chains.business_mechanism: Valuation, ownership, liquidity, options/short interest, credit/funding and event reaction determine whether business improvement creates attractive risk/reward.
chains.minimum_quality_bar: Do not make price-in claims without capital-feedback evidence.
failure_conditions: business momentum is converted into investment recommendation without valuation/positioning evidence
chains.writer_must_say: Business evidence can be positive while market price-in remains unresolved until capital-feedback pack is available.

chains.question_answered: What would weaken or change the AI/Semis thesis?
chains.business_mechanism: Counter-thesis turns uncertainty into monitorable risk factors and prevents proxy evidence from becoming overconfident judgment.
chains.minimum_quality_bar: Every positive thesis must carry counter-thesis and what-would-change conditions.
failure_conditions: counter-thesis is absent from main judgment
chains.writer_must_say: A credible workpaper states both the current bounded view and the evidence that would change it.
